scope: Numerical and causal verification of an exploratory coarse-grained model; not an empirical fit or validation of human cell development.

timestepRefinement.interpretation: Deterministic uncrowded continuous-growth test. Does not establish convergence of individual stochastic branching trajectories or every collision event.

contactClassification.interpretation: Synthetic continuously driven apposition fixture verifies the 0.3 h model threshold and loss on separation; no functional synapse is demonstrated.

ensemble.interpretation: Seed-to-seed variation inside this model, not a biological or clinical confidence interval.

interventions.interpretation: Matched initial seeds and clamped soma surfaces isolate growth-cone interventions from elastic root stretching. Event streams may diverge after interventions; these are model causal controls, not biological effect estimates.

performance.scope: Actual Node engine wall time excluding browser rendering, page load and network. Hardware dependent.

knownLimits: Human differentiation timing, growth velocities and model force parameters have not been fitted to a specified cell protocol.
Organoid mode samples neurons in a constrained volume; it does not reproduce full organogenesis, cell proliferation or tissue metabolism.
Persistent candidate contacts are not demonstrated functional synapses.
Myelination and detailed electrophysiology are outside this release.
